notes: Maximum height of a wall built to a side boundary, in storeys (A2.4.1-r2). Extract row reads '2^4 2 2^4 2^4 2 4 4' (superscript 4 run into the value): R80 2(4), LR1 2, R100 2(4), R160 2(4), MR1 2, MR2 4, HR1 to HR3 4 (merged); agrees with C4P2-028 to C4P2-033. Row header superscripts read '1,2,3' although note 1 is the street setback note (C4P2-028, C4P2-064). Rows also match the current names (R-AC4 = LR1, R-AC3 = MR2, R-AC1 = HR1, R-AC0 = R-PA; register C4P2-017). R-AC2 has no column and no row. The generic LR, MR and HR bands have no row (MR and HR each span columns with different values), so a site coded only LR, MR or HR is NOT_APPLICABLE until its code is known.
